test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Eduardo, Abraham and Xavier can finish a certain piece of work in 12, 10 and 15 days, respectively. All three of them started the work together. Eduardo left the work after 2 days and Abraham left just three days before the work was completed. Find the total number of days taken for the work to be completed.
solution:
**Given:**

Eduardo = 12 days Abraham = 10 days Xavier = 15 days

**Calculation:**

LCM of 12, 10 and 15 is 60.

Eduardo = 60/12= 5 units per day

Abraham = 60/10= 6 units per day

Xavier = 60/15 = 4 units per day

Work done by Eduardo in 2 days: ⇒ 2 × 5
